panels.description: In the lower chamber, a civic display offers designated executive authority, direct water equalization and debt clearance. Keep upper display clear.
Alex sees projected images of Grandmother safe, Keel supplied and his debt erased. Keep upper projections clear.
Ada catches Alex's wrist beside the tempting authorization display. Keep upper hands and display clear.
Alex turns away; Mera's unlinked pearl-grey band remains beside the two linked bands. Keep upper table clear.

items.text:
DESIGNATED EXECUTIVE AUTHORITY: AVAILABLE.
DIRECT WATER EQUALIZATION.
DEBT CLEARANCE: AVAILABLE.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: If we hold all the keys, everyone waits for our hands.
